reason: The cited evidence does not support sluggish diffusion as a general HEA property (E1 shows differential, not sluggish, diffusion), provides no data on grain-boundary effects, and only loosely supports the role of Al/Cr content (E3) and Ti reduction (E2) in specific, different alloy systems, leaving most key premises unsupported.
premises: Sluggish diffusion in HEAs controls outward transport of Al and Cr
Refined grain structure accelerates selective transport of protective elements
Duplex oxide scale (Cr-rich outer + internal Al2O3 or CrTaO4) forms a protective barrier
Optimized Al/Cr content promotes protective oxide formation
Reduced Ti content promotes CrTaO4 formation and oxidation resistance
